latestVersion.changelog:
brackets-bot 0.1.0 initial release:

- Introduces onboarding flow to guide users through building NCAA brackets using BracketsBot CLI.
- Supports three bracket-picking modes: stepwise chat (“Together”), general rule (“Instructed”), and custom-coded model (“Coded”).
- Provides clear submission options: shareable frontend link for browser-based wallet signing or transaction payload for CLI/wallet tool.
- Emphasizes validation before submission and offers recommended workflows for each picking mode.
- Includes detailed CLI command usage and guidance on when to use each.
